name: sourcemap
description: Maintains a bidirectional-graph of the project's files relationships with LLM-fillable context notes. Keeps it in sync with the filesystem, and helps the agent scope which files are relevant to a task via a lightweight subagent.

settings.name: ONNX Runtime library
settings.description: Absolute path to a local ONNX Runtime library (dylib/so) for deepgraph's offline semantic search. Leave empty to build deepgraph without semantic search.

settings.name: Embedding model directory
settings.description: Absolute path to a local embedding model directory, e.g. Xenova/all-MiniLM-L6-v2. Leave empty if not using semantic search.

settings.name: LLM annotation
settings.description: true (default): qwen writes a one-sentence note per file in the background, which makes search much better but uses your qwen quota (roughly one call per 10 files, then only for changed files). false: no LLM calls; search matches file paths and exported names only.

settings.name: Exclude patterns
settings.description: Comma-separated gitignore-style globs, relative to the project root, that the sourcemap should skip (.gitignore is already respected). Leave empty for none.

settings.name: OpenAI API logging
settings.description: Set to true to pass --openai-logging to every qwen call the extension makes in the background. Leave empty or false to disable.
